_comment: Reference copy of what the search admin enters in the connection wizard.
No credential appears here. The connector authenticates to SQL using
DataSource:SqlAuthMode from appsettings.json on the agent host, which is
WindowsIntegrated: the service account identity is the credential.
Anything typed into the wizard's credential fields is logged as ignored and
discarded. TrustServerCertificate is deliberately absent; it is rejected
